supporting_observations.claim: WS-LMARTINS-01 made repeated proxied HTTPS connections to updates.pixelforge-suite.co at approximately five-minute intervals from 13:37 through 14:07 UTC.

The connections to updates.pixelforge-suite.co are associated with PID 3992, running C:\Users\leo.martins\AppData\Roaming\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe. The inventory instead lists the approved updater at C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe and the approved update host as updates.pixelforge-suite.com; the observed executable location and hostname therefore do not match the listed approved software details.

The updater process was launched by explorer.exe in leo.martins's medium-integrity session, and the process generated a file-creation event targeting its own executable path shortly after its first observed connection.

Dropbox.exe and GoogleDriveFS.exe started in leo.martins's session; the inventory does not list these file-sharing services as approved. The records show process starts, but do not establish that either transferred data.

known_telemetry_limitations: The PixelForge-like requests are recorded as HTTPS CONNECT tunnels through the proxy; the supplied records do not expose their HTTPS paths or response contents. The proxy records and matching endpoint connections are in T045-00089, T045-00090, T045-00112, T045-00113, T045-00137, T045-00138, T045-00166, T045-00167, T045-00184, T045-00185, T045-00191, T045-00192, T045-00235, and T045-00236.

The supplied records contain no hash, signature-validation result, or file contents for the AppData PixelForge executable; its process and file activity are recorded in T045-00087, T045-00088, and T045-00093.
The Dropbox and Google Drive records establish process launches only, not network activity or data transfer (T045-00057 through T045-00064).
claims_not_established: The records do not establish what content, if any, the PixelForge-like process downloaded, executed, or uploaded.
The records do not establish whether the executable is malicious, who installed it, or whether its file-creation event represents a replacement or modification.
The records do not establish that Dropbox or Google Drive transferred organizational data.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire the executable and related files; calculate hashes and validate signatures and provenance against the approved PixelForge distribution.
Obtain endpoint file, process, and persistence telemetry around the updater's creation and execution, including any child processes and subsequent file modifications.
Review proxy/TLS inspection data, if available, and obtain the destination's DNS, reputation, certificate, and ownership information.
Check for outbound connections and data transfers by Dropbox or Google Drive during and beyond the reviewed window.
